articles.title: Crypto exchange HTX exits the UK after settling with the FCA
articles.snippet: The former Huobi exchange has stopped accepting deposits from British customers and agreed not to target them with crypto promotions.

articles.title: Justin Sun's HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With Financial Watchdog
articles.snippet: The FCA says the Justin Sun-linked exchange will no longer target UK consumers, ending its first case against a crypto firm over marketing.
